report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 78ms, zero dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR span (gateway call inventory, 1007ms) exists, and topology shows inventory depends on redis. Insufficient evidence to bound any taxonomy candidate; hand off for missing telemetry.
